# Hermes

> Hermes is a browser-based running analytics app for turning activity data into clearer training decisions.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://hermesruns.com/): Running analytics with VO2max estimates, training pace zones, race predictions, route heatmaps, and shoe mileage tracking.
- [Terms of Service](https://hermesruns.com/terms): Terms for using Hermes, connected activity imports, training insights, and account features.
- [Privacy Policy](https://hermesruns.com/privacy): How Hermes handles account details, connected activity data, training metrics, retention, and privacy choices.

## Product facts

- Strava sync is the recommended way to keep running activities current.
- GPX, FIT, and TCX file imports are also supported.
- Hermes is informational training support, not medical advice or emergency guidance.
